scheme_name: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Jharkhand
Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste of Jharkhand
Applicant must be enrolled in a state government‑recognized school
Applicable for students studying in classes 1 to 10
benefits_summary: Financial assistance covering hostel and day‑school expenses, ranging from ₹1,500 for classes 1‑5 up to ₹4,500 for classes 9‑10, transferred directly to beneficiaries’ bank accounts.
